description: Generate a Studio artifact: audio, video, report, interactive_report, slide_deck, mind_map, quiz, flashcards, infographic or data_table. Each kind takes only the option values a live capture has proven (the enums); other values the web app offers return UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT naming the option, before any call. Omitted options take the web app's defaults. instructions is optional for audio, video, slide_deck and quiz, required for report, mind_map, flashcards and data_table, and refused by infographic and interactive_report (each as captured). video.generate_later asks for deferred generation (cinematic format only). report needs report.title and report.description plus instructions as the prompt (suggest surface report returns ready-made triples). Checks the account quota first and returns a QUOTA error when it is used up. Artifacts are built from the notebook's sources only, not notes (the web app can add notes; that is not supported). Returns the new artifact as pending; poll studio_list for its status. Not retried after sending.

quantity.description: number of cards: fewer, standard (default standard)

detail.description: level of detail: concise, standard (default standard)

instructions.description: free text: audio and video focus, slide deck description and quiz topic (optional); report prompt, data table description, mind map and flashcards topic (required); infographic and interactive_report take none

language.description: output language code as the web app sends it (default en; cinematic video takes none)

notebook.description: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

quantity.description: number of questions: standard, more (default standard)

description.description: report description (required), for example from suggest surface report

title.description: report title (required), for example from suggest surface report

format.description: slide deck format: detailed_deck, presenter_slides (default detailed_deck)

length.description: slide deck length: default, short (default default)

sources.description: source ids, id prefixes or titles; default all sources (notes cannot be used as sources)

generate_later.description: the web app's Generate later (deferred generation; the artifact lists as pending until Google runs it); cinematic format only

name: studio_generate
